answer_quote: **Yes.** In this image, the medial layer is visibly thinned (attenuated) directly beneath the most advanced, lipid-rich portion of the atherosclerotic plaque when compared with the thicker, intact medial band on the opposite side of the arterial wall.
note: 图中可见斑块下方中膜层较对侧变窄，解释与可见形态一致。
